description: Strictly verify that a discovered title belongs to an exact DOI record before citing it. Returns citeAllowed=false for mismatches, absent records, or incomplete canonical metadata. citationRecord contains only registry fields and must never be completed by inference. This verifies bibliographic identity only; claims still require page or section evidence from the document.

expectedAuthors.description: Optional complete author list from the candidate, in order. If supplied, every author must match the registry.

expectedTitle.description: Exact title returned by the discovery provider. It is compared with the DOI registry before citation is allowed.

expectedYear.description: Optional publication year from the candidate. If supplied, it must match the registry.

name: campus_research_verify_citation
